Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 19
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded that all 97 listings had .ps versions by misinterpreting the “other formats” link on the category listing page as evidence of .ps availability. They did not verify per-article “other formats” pages or use the API to check for actual .ps links, leading to an unsubstantiated and likely incorrect count and assumption.
